description: Use this when the user wants to compare 2 to 5 US stocks or ETFs side by side (e.g. "VOO vs QQQ", "SCHD or VYM?"): returns, drawdown, volatility, Sharpe, beta, dividend yield and how correlated they are, with an overlaid 1Y/5Y chart. End-of-day data for US large and mid caps, major foreign stocks and US ETFs. Not for intraday quotes or recommendations on what to buy.

tickers.description: Tickers to compare, in the order the user named them

items.description: US ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL, VOO or BRK.B

name: compare_securities

asOf.description: Market date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the latest close behind every number

matrix.description: Pearson correlation of daily returns over the past year, in the order of `tickers`

matrix5y.description: Pearson correlation of weekly returns over the past five years, in the order of `tickers`; null where a ticker has less history. One year can be far from the usual relationship, so mention both when they differ much

beta1y.description: Versus SPY, from daily returns over the past year

dividendYieldPct.description: Trailing 12-month dividend yield: dividends that went ex in the past year over the latest close. 0 pays none; null when unknown (paid in another currency)

maxDrawdown1yPct.description: Worst peak-to-trough fall over the past year (negative)

sector.description: GICS sector for stocks, category for ETFs

statsSince.description: YYYY-MM-DD, set only when there is less than a year of history: the 1Y figures (return, drawdown, volatility, Sharpe, Sortino, beta, alpha, yield) then run from this first close, and so does the YTD return if it falls this year. Screens on those metrics leave such securities out

volatility1yPct.description: Annualized standard deviation of daily returns over the past year

title: Compare stocks or ETFs
